purpose: Frozen, portable numeric evidence for reported two-deck highway detours, the identified adaptive PATH runtime-height defect, and its bounded source repair.
status: historical installed candidate failed; repaired candidate awaits matching human retest

human_report.record_type: paraphrase of the reported behavior, not a verbatim quotation
human_report.result: Through traffic exits the highway, follows the Avenue, makes a U-turn, and re-enters the same-direction highway instead of crossing the elevated bridge.
human_report.scope: Failure is confirmed only for the reported parallel assembly situation. No individual rotation, Route Query case, visible-car case, or other assembly outcome is inferred.

saved_resource_measurements.saved_through_journeys_scope: Two native lanes per opposing deck. Saved graph agreement precedes the game runtime transform and does not establish game pathfinding.

engine_branch_proof.basis: Read-only inspection of the fingerprinted local Windows 1.1.641 executable, cross-checked against the pinned primary reverse-engineering contract.

text_header_parser.meaning: Zero disables UseElevation; a nonzero header integer enables it.

CreateTransformedCopy.identified_defect: Normal-group adaptive aliases retain UseElevation=false and therefore replace saved elevated route heights with the surface occupant altitude. The native override pipeline enables elevation first.

lane_continuity.scope: The primary engine contract uses three-dimensional endpoint distance. The source regression replays only this bounded endpoint consequence on flat terrain, not the complete traffic simulator.

bounded_repair.accepted_type: strict Boolean; integer lookalikes are rejected
bounded_repair.true: Emit header 1 in active aliases only.
bounded_repair.absent_or_false: Retain legacy header 0 and its existing bytes.
preserve: every route coordinate and metadata field

software_evidence.portable_regression_scope: Confirmed surface-copy height branch on flat terrain, both native deck heights, ground height, proper rotations, declared active-header validation, and legacy resource preservation. This is a synthetic replay, not a game observation.

independent_focused_tests.scope: Adaptive schema, writer, verifier, construction, connector alias handling, single and multiple menus, and a separate review of the decoded runtime-branch regression.

old_resource_regeneration.scope: Read-only regeneration of extra active resources from the unchanged accepted canonical model/PATH inputs. It is not a fresh native build, an installed update, or a game test.

public_redaction: Only numeric findings, source identities, and fingerprints are published. Private paths, executable instruction bytes, native model buffers, saved-city data, and proprietary texture pixels remain private.
